messages.subject: Gray screen
messages.body_plain:
Hello Wallace crew,

I am getting a grey screen when trying to do a maxent run. Ive used the dataset before many times in Wallace and have changed no settings but now every time I try I get a grey screen moments after I run the models. I've updated R and R studio and all the requisite packages and tried again to receive the same results. I've attached a snip of the error from my console. I've tried to get Wallace to run with other user specified and queried occurrences and predictors and even tried installing Wallace on another machine and I keep getting that grey screen. I'm unsure if its a problem on my end or if its Wallace, last time I ran Wallace on my machine was about two weeks ago and it was running without hiccups. Any help or guidance would be appreciated. Please let me know if there is other info you require from me.

Thanks in advance for the help!

-Justin

messages.subject: Re: Gray screen
messages.body_plain:
Hi Justin,

I figured out the problem. Please, specify a study region buffer higher than 0.05 (this is for your user-occs, this value could change with other occurrences). I was able to reproduce the issue with your files (thanks!). Technically, the problem is on the raster::mask() that it is used internally on Wallace. This function is removing rasters cells that are in the border of your raster, so some of your occurrences are getting NA values. For more info, you can check this link. <https://gis.stackexchange.com/questions/255025/r-raster-masking-a-raster-by-polygon-also-remove-cells-partially-covered>

This issue will be fixed in the next version of Wallace (v2.0).

I hope that this 'temporal' solution can fix your problem. Please, let me know if it works for you.

Thanks again for writing to us!

Best,
Gonzalo
